pilot: wide_1 seed1 all three methods, reused verbatim in54; no reruns
secondary: Unchanged dense+bridge frozen TerminalLOS S/E and S/K; no selection of D1 variants for these runs
map_rule: All six maps and supplied controls frozen before any search. Validate all six witnesses in actual SI plus independent Python and RK4. No witness controls in planner requests. No holdout maps and no additional radius sweep.
timing_rule: Charge native startup/serialization/return and independent first/final control certification to10s. Store original clocks before subsequent validation can throw. Native event clocks are not independent Python certificate times.
decision_rule: Six map clusters with three seeds each are development evidence, not independently validated performance. SST robust coverage >=5/6 maps with >=2/3 strict successes in each is preregistered as evidence against a broad baseline bottleneck; no GO based only on lower coverage.
